verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਕਵਾਉ ਅਮਾਉ ਜਿਸ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡੇ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau amaau jis kevadd vadde dhee vaddiaaiee|

en.bdb: What could be said about the greatness of that great Lord whose one word is beyond all measures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: oa(n)kaar akaar jis tis dhaa a(n)t na kouoo paiee|

en.bdb: None can know His mystery whose base is only One Gallia". How could His long life be counted whose half a breath is unfathom­able.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਧਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: adhaa saahu athaahu jis vaddee aarajaa ganat na aaiee|

en.bdb: His creation cannot be evaluated; how can then that imperceptible one be beholden (understood).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kudharat keem na jaaneeaai kaadhar alakh na lakhiaa jaiee|

en.bdb: His gifts such as days and nights are also invalu­able and His other boons are also infinite.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhaat na keem na raat dhih besumaar dhaataar khudhaiee|

en.bdb: Indescribable is the position of the Lord, the master of the masterless,

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਅਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: abigat gat anaath naath akath kathaa net net alaiee|

en.bdb: And His unnarratable story can only be concluded by saying neti neti (this is not, this not).
Worthy of salutation is only that primeval Lord.
